title: Cuba and Latin America
goal: See how the revolution reached the rest of Latin America, and say what was done to Cuba and to Che Guevara with the ser passive.

items: I can say how young people and governments reacted to the Cuban revolution.
I can say what happened to Cuba in the OAS in 1962.
I can say what Mexico did.
I can say what happened to Che Guevara in Bolivia.
I can say what was done to someone with ser + past participle.
